description: This file defines an integration module for Azure Sentinel, implementing a custom logger class 'AzureSentinelLogger' that sends logs to Azure Log Analytics via the Logs Ingestion API. It includes environment variable handling, OAuth2 token management, batch logging, and API communication.

classes.name: AzureSentinelLogger
classes.description: A custom logger class for sending LiteLLM logs to Azure Sentinel via the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API.

methods.description: Initializes the AzureSentinelLogger with configuration parameters, environment variable fallbacks, and sets up HTTP client and OAuth token handling.

methods.description: Fetches or retrieves a cached OAuth2 Bearer token for authenticating API requests to Azure Monitor.

methods.name: async_log_success_event( self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time )
methods.description: Handles batching of successful log events by appending to the queue and triggering batch send when the batch size is reached.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event( self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time )
methods.description: Handles batching of failed log events, similar to success events, with error handling.

methods.name: async_send_batch(self)
methods.description: Sends the accumulated batched logs to Azure Log Analytics using the Logs Ingestion API, handling OAuth token inclusion, response validation, and error logging.
